purpose: Screen the 23 taxon labels printed in the Ihawan Spring survey against current fish-name references while retaining the exact source labels and separating nomenclature from specimen identification and local occurrence.

studySource.sourceTable: Checklist of collected fish species; Table 2

authority.institution: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.catalogVersion: Online records dated 7 July or 13 August 2026 where the page/index exposed an update date; reviewed 31 October 2026.
authority.accessMethod: Official Catalog species records were checked directly where accessible and through indexed records when direct retrieval returned 403. WoRMS was used for Ambassis interrupta and Suezichthys gracilis; the WoRMS/NCBI taxonomy record was used for Periophthalmus gracilis. This is a nomenclature screen, not a complete taxonomic revision.
authority.reuse: No item-specific republication license for the Catalog or WoRMS records was verified. Only concise attributed name-status summaries and links are retained.

limitations: A valid or accepted name does not confirm that the survey specimen was identified correctly.
No voucher accession, repository record or taxon-to-station photograph crosswalk was found in the article review.
The four flagged locality/habitat combinations require source or voucher follow-up; distribution summaries do not prove absence or invalidate a report.
The source spelling Liza vaigeinsis is retained exactly; all candidate name changes are crosswalks only.
No fish name in this crosswalk is promoted to current presence, local diet, safety, legal or public-app evidence.
nextAction: Seek vouchers, station-level photographs or author clarification for Bostrychus expatria, Diodon holocanthus, Archamia bleekeri and Suezichthys gracilis; otherwise preserve the full 23-label list as historical research-only evidence and continue with the next independent Caraga inland-water primary source.
